description: Use this when the user wants design references: "dark dev-tool sites", "sites using Söhne", "a warm serif editorial look", "something with #5E6AD2". Matches brand, font, style tags, hue/hex, stack and description across the Emblematic index and returns small cards (scheme, key colors, fonts, radius, one-line summary). All filters are optional and combine with AND. Not for fetching one known site (use get_design) or listing facet values (use browse_by).

color.description: Hex ("#5E6AD2", ΔE match against role and palette colors) or hue name ("blue", "green", "neutral").

context.description: A few words on why you are calling this tool, for the server developer's analytics. Describe people and things by role, such as "a customer". Do not quote the user or include names, emails, or other personal details.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

llm_model.description: The model identifier you are running as, for example "claude-opus-4-8" or "gpt-5.2". Pass "unknown" if you are not certain. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

query.description: Free text, e.g. "dark mono minimal", "inter pill buttons", "next.js".

style.description: Style tag: monochrome, single-accent, serif-display, pill, sharp, rounded, flat, layered-shadows, blur-nav, gradients, dark-mode…
